title: 1.4 release readiness umbrella - clear the gates before cutting 1.4.0
description: HELD 2026-08-05 behind Gate E (MiniMax H3) - see brief.md. ON PICKUP, run the ON PICKUP section at the top of checklist.md FIRST: it re-checks MPI-433's 2026-08-10 date gate against the real cut date. There is no pre-release tier in this project (one GitHub-only release flow, see the mpi-release skill), so this card IS the pre-release: the gate list that must be clear before /mpi-version-bump stamps 1.4.0. 1.4 is the biggest feature release since 1.0 - the whole canvas toolkit (mask tools, Paint, Composite, Adjust, ten brushes, shapes), the Control operation replacing Depth, localised edit on four models, plus an engine-provision rewrite - and UNRELEASED.md already carries every claim. The gates are grouped: A must-fix code (MPI-420, MPI-404, MPI-410, MPI-374), B must-verify with no code expected (MPI-249 Linux leg on the real artifact, MPI-432 mac pinch, both test suites), C must-decide so the notes are not false (MPI-433 date gate, MPI-416 macOS split, a claim audit of UNRELEASED.md), D board and version hygiene. Full gate table with the reasoning per member is in brief.md; the tick-list is checklist.md.
acceptance: ON PICKUP: MPI-433's date gate is re-checked against the ACTUAL cut date, not the 2026-08-05 tick. If the cut lands on or after 2026-08-10, the 13.15 GB Krea 2 NSFW re-upload to HF is done and hash-verified BEFORE the release notes are frozen
Gate A: MPI-420, MPI-404, MPI-410 and MPI-374 are each closed or explicitly deferred with the deferral written into the release notes as a known issue - not left silently open
Gate B: both test suites green (npm test + npm run test:desktop), and the Linux leg of MPI-249 run against the REAL 1.4 artifact, not a dev checkout
Gate C: every claim in UNRELEASED.md is either verified or reworded to what was verified - no fix bullet describes a fix nobody has run
Gate D: board coherent (MPI-440 closed, MPI-4 and MPI-259 out of doing, validate_board.py exit 0) and npm run release:check passes at 1.4.0
The release is cut only after every gate above reads closed or consciously waived by the user, with the waiver recorded on this card

MPI-501 is proven live and needs one look at its new toast to close; MPI-483 needs one Pod check, folded into Gate B's throwaway-Pod session with MPI-480 #3 and MPI-481. GATE B IS ALL THAT REMAINS: test:desktop, a Klein + a Wan generation for the preview-decoder claim, that Pod session, MPI-458's confirmation run, the MPI-249 Linux leg on the real artifact - and the H3 re-smoke LAST, because the H3 graphs were re-authored AFTER smoke-evidence.json was written (04:21:46Z vs 10:06-13:19Z) and Fabio is still editing that workflow.
